cells.scene: An adult solves a practical problem by making a simple bridge from spare wooden pieces across a small garden ditch, thoughtful clever construction.
An astronomer looks through a telescope toward a star-filled night sky, observatory dome and a simple star chart nearby.
The same medium-sized apple appears large beside a tiny berry and small beside a large melon in two parallel views; comparison determines apparent size.
A scientifically ordered simplified solar system with the Sun at center and distinct planets at increasing distances, planet sizes and spacing intentionally schematic, no extra moons dominating.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — ingenuity (n.机灵): An adult solves a practical problem by making a simple bridge from spare wooden pieces across a small garden ditch, thoughtful clever construction.
TOP RIGHT — astronomy (n.天文学): An astronomer looks through a telescope toward a star-filled night sky, observatory dome and a simple star chart nearby.
BOTTOM LEFT — relative (a.相对的): The same medium-sized apple appears large beside a tiny berry and small beside a large melon in two parallel views; comparison determines apparent size.
BOTTOM RIGHT — solar (a.太阳系的): A scientifically ordered simplified solar system with the Sun at center and distinct planets at increasing distances, planet sizes and spacing intentionally schematic, no extra moons dominating.
review_notes: Viewed clever ditch bridge construction, telescope astronomy, same-size apples compared to berry and melon, and eight ordered solar-system planets. Planets in Mercury/Venus/Earth/Mars/Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune order, schematically spaced and sized. Full cell clearance.
